crossRefs.note: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
crossRefs.keyword: two mites."It is the seventh part of one piece of that brass money."

translations.web: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
translations.bsb: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
translations.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
translations.asv: And there came a poor widow, and she cast in two mites, which make a farthing.
